albums.title: GROWTH
albums.description: This album was created during a pivotal period of personal growth, as I began to recognize and address habits that were holding me back. It reflects my commitment to making positive changes, including embracing a healthier lifestyle and focusing on building a more stable and purposeful future.

albums.title: YOUTH
albums.description: This album was written earlier in my life and captures a more carefree and unstructured phase of my personal journey. While my perspective has evolved since then, these experiences played an important role in shaping my growth, creativity, and the person I am today.

albums.title: Lifes Been Great
albums.description: This album is a collaboration with my friend and producer JDS, a lifelong musician with a strong background in guitar and vocal performance. JDS was responsible for producing and mixing each track, bringing a cohesive and polished sound to the project.

projects.title: Music Player
projects.description: This is one of my first projects in web development. It is a fully functional music player built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features three albums, each in various lengths, with the ability to play, pause, skip forward, and skip backward. It also features an interactive progress bar that updates as the song plays, background color that updates based on the album, and a responsive design that looks good on both desktop and mobile devices.

projects.title: NFL Stats Dashboard
projects.description: A live NFL stats dashboard featuring a scrolling score ticker, season leader cards with animated counters, full AFC/NFC standings, stat leader charts powered by Chart.js, and a real-time player search that pulls data from the ESPN public API — including player bios, headshots, and season stats by position. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features a galaxy background that matches the portfolio theme.

projects.title: Couch Brotato
projects.description: A website I designed for choosing a movie based on streaming service and genre. It features a rating system that pulls data from the TMDB API, listing movies and tv shows in order from highest to lowest rated. The website also shows the previews for movies upon click and has a feature to add movies to a watchlist that is stored in local storage. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
